reason: My nights get filled by my PR guys and the WhatsApp lists, not by an app nobody has installed yet. A free month is nice, but I'm not signing a 3-month minimum with a startup that has zero users.
objection: You're a startup with no public app yet, so who is actually going to open it? And will you still be around in six months?
